summary: Real yields climbed to 2.90% on 10-year TIPS, well above trend, extending pressure on gold and long Treasuries even as the dollar held firm near multi-week highs. Equities stayed buoyant on narrow tech-led rotation (Nasdaq names outpacing staples) despite thin overall participation. Crypto's rally remained stretched, with momentum readings near overbought levels on cooling volume.
tweet: Elevated real yields and a firm dollar kept gold and bonds under pressure Tuesday, while narrow tech-led gains propped up stocks and crypto stayed overbought on fading volume.
